assumptions: Every claim carries an explicit evidence context and type.
equations.claim_ceiling: Evidence typing only; no scientific truth follows from the type label.
equations.falsifier: A promoted claim whose required evidence type is absent or silently cast from another type.
equations.name: Typed evidence judgement
equations.uncertainty_rule: Evidence type and statistical confidence are separate fields.

assumptions: Dependencies are addressable and the dependency graph has a finite reachable subgraph.
equations.claim_ceiling: Accounting boundary definition; it does not prove that inventory is complete.
equations.domain: Systems, devices, processes, providers, and phone boundary
equations.expression: cl(x)=mu Z ({x} union Union_{z in Z} dep(z))
equations.falsifier: An essential dependency required for execution is outside the computed closure.
equations.name: Full-system dependency closure
equations.uncertainty_rule: Unknown dependencies remain explicit unresolved nodes.

assumptions: Overlapping resources use stable identifiers and are deduplicated.
equations.claim_ceiling: Accounting identity; unmeasured resource values remain null.
equations.falsifier: Double-counting or omission changes the resource total under the same boundary.
equations.name: Dependency-closed resource total
equations.uncertainty_rule: Propagate joint uncertainty and covariance; do not add independent intervals when dependence is unknown.

assumptions: Metrics, orientations, thresholds, and normalizers are frozen before evaluation.
equations.claim_ceiling: Contract-relative robust margin, not universal superiority.
equations.domain: Useful-output, material, device, and service contracts
equations.falsifier: Any required metric has a lower robust margin below zero.
equations.name: Functional acceptance margin
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use preregistered uncertainty set U and confidence level alpha; unknown uncertainty blocks the robust claim.

assumptions: All numeric and categorical terms are frozen in the useful-output contract.
equations.claim_ceiling: Binary acceptance for one frozen contract only.
equations.domain: One candidate under one useful-output contract
equations.falsifier: A required numeric margin or categorical predicate fails.
equations.name: Functional acceptance predicate
equations.uncertainty_rule: No pass when a required input or uncertainty bound is null.

assumptions: Each attempted output has a frozen acceptance result.
equations.claim_ceiling: Counts accepted outputs; it does not establish independence between attempts.
equations.falsifier: Recomputing the frozen acceptance predicate changes the recorded count.
equations.name: Accepted-output count
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report sampling interval and dependence model when generalizing beyond observed attempts.

assumptions: Lifecycle cost and energy use the same dependency closure and observation window as accepted outputs.
equations.claim_ceiling: Observed ratios only; zero accepted outputs or incomplete numerator yields null.
equations.domain: Throughput, cost, and energy per accepted output
equations.falsifier: A numerator term, accepted-output count, or observation window is mismatched.
equations.name: Accepted-output performance and resource ratios
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use ratio uncertainty with numerator/denominator covariance; division is refused at N_acc=0.

assumptions: Candidate and per-unit reference share workload, time horizon, quality, and required capability coordinates.
equations.claim_ceiling: Equivalent units for the named subsystem and contract only.
equations.domain: GPU, CPU, NPU, RAM, VRAM/HBM, and persistent-storage replacement
equations.falsifier: Any required semantic or capability coordinate is missing, below threshold, or compared under a different contract.
equations.name: Accepted equivalent subsystem units
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use a simultaneous lower confidence bound across all bottleneck ratios.

assumptions: Both systems pass the same acceptance contract and have complete lifecycle ledgers.
equations.claim_ceiling: Cost advantage for one matched useful service; no universal advantage.
equations.falsifier: Contract, boundary, currency, time basis, accepted-output denominator, or bill provenance differs.
equations.name: Accepted-output cost advantage
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report a lower confidence bound; target passes only when the bound exceeds the threshold.

assumptions: The target service portfolio and phone-class numeric boundaries are separately frozen.
equations.claim_ceiling: Mission decision predicate; no present feasibility is implied.
equations.expression: PhoneReady=All_w A_w AND essential(cl(x)) subset x AND V<=Vmax AND M<=Mmax AND Price<=Pmax AND Thermal<=ThermalMax AND Reliability>=Rmin
equations.falsifier: Any essential external dependency or service/resource boundary fails.
equations.name: Phone-class mission closure
equations.uncertainty_rule: Every conjunct uses a simultaneous conservative bound; unknown is not pass.

assumptions: Eligible provider set is date-stamped and each stage is independently evidenced.
equations.claim_ceiling: Provider maturity vector; discovery or simulation is not hardware execution.
equations.falsifier: A stage is marked complete without its required artifact or the denominator omits eligible providers.
equations.name: Date-stamped provider portability
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report each component separately with inventory date; do not collapse to one pass score.

assumptions: Reference, compiler, lowering, execution, and normalization all use the same workload contract.
equations.claim_ceiling: Correctness for the tested provider and contract only.
equations.falsifier: Normalized provider result exceeds the frozen output distance or uses contract drift.
equations.name: Provider lowering equivalence
equations.uncertainty_rule: Include shot, calibration, stochastic, and decoding uncertainty in d_w.

assumptions: Application-visible observables and the admissible input domain are frozen.
equations.claim_ceiling: Semantic replacement for one application; not literal memory-cell equivalence.
equations.domain: RAM, VRAM/HBM, storage, and state semantic elimination
equations.expression: d_w(O_w(F_x(u)),O_w(F_ref(u)))<=epsilon_w for all u in U_w
equations.falsifier: A valid input produces application-visible output beyond tolerance or violates access/persistence semantics.
equations.name: Application-visible state equivalence
equations.uncertainty_rule: The quantified input domain and probabilistic error rate must be explicit.

assumptions: Outputs are classically distinguishable and the channel is noiseless for the displayed bound.
equations.claim_ceiling: Output information lower bound; not a full memory-capacity theorem.
equations.falsifier: A protocol reconstructs every member of Y with fewer noiseless bits under the same distinguishability assumptions.
equations.name: Distinguishable-output bit bound
equations.uncertainty_rule: Noisy or lossy outputs require an explicit coding/error correction bound.

assumptions: A valid composition theorem justifies the chosen component-error aggregation.
equations.claim_ceiling: Upper-bound ledger, not a measured hardware error without measurements.
equations.domain: Algorithm, synthesis, input, implementation, and sampling error
equations.falsifier: The required composition theorem does not apply or an error component is omitted.
equations.name: End-to-end error ledger
equations.uncertainty_rule: Dependence and coherent error require a justified non-additive bound when applicable.

variables.unit_or_type: same metric or proved compatible norm

assumptions: Polynomial parity, domain, norm, and target function are explicit.
equations.claim_ceiling: Polynomial certificate only; not phase synthesis, provider transpilation, or hardware execution.
equations.falsifier: Exact or certified evaluation violates boundedness or approximation tolerance.
equations.name: QSVT bounded approximation
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use certified arithmetic or an explicit grid-to-continuum bound.

assumptions: Device requirements, material lot, process settings, measurement method, and controls are frozen.
equations.claim_ceiling: Qualification and yield for the sampled process distribution only.
equations.expression: Q_D=1[q(m_E,z_G) succeeds r_D]; Y_G=Pr(q(m_E,z_G) succeeds r_D)
equations.falsifier: Qualified metrics fail the requirement vector or reproduced yield falls outside the stated interval.
equations.name: Device qualification and process yield
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report lot, metrology, calibration, sampling, and process-drift uncertainty.

assumptions: All numerator terms and site count share one production boundary; yield is measured.
equations.claim_ceiling: Modeled or measured qualified-device cost according to the evidence type of every input.
equations.falsifier: A required cost term, site count, or measured yield is absent or boundary-mismatched.
equations.name: Yield-adjusted device cost
equations.uncertainty_rule: Yield and correlated cost uncertainty propagate to a reported interval; Y_G=0 or null refuses division.

assumptions: Reference and candidate deliver the same accepted material function.
equations.claim_ceiling: Reduction of the named element under one functional-unit contract.
equations.falsifier: Functional qualification fails or candidate element inventory is not lower.
equations.name: Element-specific critical-material reduction
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report measurement and inventory bounds separately for each element.

assumptions: System boundary and inventory interval are explicit.
equations.claim_ceiling: Mass conservation ledger; it does not prove product identity or performance.
equations.domain: Biomass conversion, material processing, and fuel production
equations.falsifier: Measured closure residual exceeds the preregistered uncertainty bound.
equations.name: Material conservation boundary
equations.uncertainty_rule: Propagate flow-meter, assay, moisture, sampling, and inventory uncertainty into the closure residual.

assumptions: Product quality is accepted and coproduct credits are nonduplicated.
equations.claim_ceiling: Lifecycle cost per accepted delivered energy for the specified pathway.
equations.domain: Biomass bio-oil, biofuel, or refinery intermediate
equations.falsifier: A required cost, quality, mass-yield, heating-value, or logistics term is missing or double-counted.
equations.name: Accepted liquid-energy cost
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report sensitivity and joint interval across yield, quality, uptime, prices, financing, and coproduct allocation.

assumptions: Power terms use the same plant boundary and time basis.
equations.claim_ceiling: Net-power identity; positive net power is not commercial electricity.
equations.falsifier: Measured plant-boundary net export disagrees outside uncertainty.
equations.name: Fusion net-power balance
equations.uncertainty_rule: Carry correlated power measurement and duty-cycle uncertainty.

assumptions: All costs and net delivered energy use one discount convention and plant boundary.
equations.claim_ceiling: Scenario or observed net LCOE according to input evidence; not a commercial result from roadmap inputs.
equations.falsifier: A lifecycle cost, downtime, replacement, decommissioning, recirculating-power, or financing term is omitted.
equations.name: Fusion net delivered LCOE
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report scenario distribution over construction, capacity factor, component life, costs, and discount rate.

assumptions: Debt balance, fees, rate convention, and time base are explicit.
equations.claim_ceiling: Absolute financing expense; no automatic rate, WACC, or policy-rate reduction.
equations.domain: R&D, plant, factory, and infrastructure financing
equations.falsifier: Loan cash flows under the same terms do not reproduce the integral/accounting schedule.
equations.name: Absolute interest and fee burden
equations.uncertainty_rule: Separate fixed-term principal/duration effects from uncertain market-rate and risk-premium effects.

assumptions: Source label, observations, and controls are preregistered; scorer is blinded.
equations.claim_ceiling: Conditional association test only; rejecting H0 does not identify a spiritual or paranormal cause.
equations.falsifier: Leakage, multiplicity, calibration failure, protocol drift, or independent non-replication invalidates attribution.
equations.name: SCM conditional-information null
equations.uncertainty_rule: Predefine estimator, null distribution, multiplicity correction, power, and confidence interval.

assumptions: Fraction f is the only accelerable cost share and speedup a adds no new overhead.
equations.claim_ceiling: Optimistic upper bound; real end-to-end AI cost advantage can only be lower unless the model changes.
equations.domain: AI training and service cost compression
equations.falsifier: A claimed advantage exceeds the bound under the stated cost decomposition without changing assumptions.
equations.name: Residual-cost compression bound
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use conservative intervals for f and a and separately add new candidate overheads.

assumptions: Every candidate records every tuple field; absent fields remain explicit null blockers.
equations.claim_ceiling: Equation-hypothesis specification only.
equations.domain: New mathematics, effective equations, and physical-theory candidates
equations.falsifier: The candidate lacks a domain, assumption, constraint, limiting case, discriminating observable, falsifier, or provenance path.
equations.name: Equation hypothesis contract
equations.uncertainty_rule: Parameter identifiability, predictive uncertainty, and domain uncertainty are separate fields.

assumptions: Applicable checks and incumbent model are declared before evaluation.
equations.claim_ceiling: Promotion gate; passing is necessary but not automatically sufficient for mission use.
equations.falsifier: Any mandatory check fails, is untested, or uses non-independent evidence while marked independent.
equations.name: Equation promotion predicate
equations.uncertainty_rule: Unknown check state is OPEN, never PASS.

assumptions: Prior, likelihood, candidate protocol, and possible outcomes are specified.
equations.claim_ceiling: Research prioritization signal; never spending or funding authorization.
equations.domain: Choice among bounded already-authorized research protocols
equations.falsifier: Posterior calculation, prior, or outcome model is unreproducible or decision-sensitive assumptions are hidden.
equations.name: Decisive-information value
equations.uncertainty_rule: Report sensitivity to prior, likelihood, and protocol cost/risk models.

assumptions: Canonical goal set, uncertainty sets, evidence predicates, provenance predicates, and non-claim predicates are complete and versioned.
equations.claim_ceiling: Project mission closure predicate; it is open until every conjunct has qualifying evidence.
equations.expression: UMCE(x,Gamma)=AND_g([inf_omega Delta_g(x,omega)>=0] AND E_g(Gamma) AND P_g(Gamma) AND N_g(Gamma))
equations.falsifier: Any canonical goal is omitted or any goal margin/evidence/provenance/non-claim conjunct fails.
equations.name: UQPU Mission Closure Equation
equations.uncertainty_rule: Use conservative simultaneous bounds; no weighted compensation between goals.

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Every frozen workload family passes UMRL-005 under the same application-visible contract.
non_claims: Compilation or simulation alone is not broad functional replacement.
goal_contracts.title: GPU/CPU/NPU workload-family functional coverage
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Per-workload simultaneous quality and performance bounds

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-011 is reported componentwise and UMRL-012 passes for each claimed provider stage.
non_claims: Provider discovery, dry run, simulation, and real-QPU validation are not interchangeable.
goal_contracts.title: Broad practical quantum-cloud portability
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Date-stamped inventory completeness and per-provider execution uncertainty

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-013 passes and every required memory/storage coordinate in UMRL-008 is measured or explicitly semantically eliminated.
non_claims: Hilbert-space dimension is not readable RAM, VRAM, HBM, or disk capacity.
goal_contracts.title: Memory/state/storage functional replacement or semantic elimination
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Coordinate-wise lower bounds with explicit noisy-output correction

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Lower confidence bound of UMRL-009 is at least 100 with complete matched ledgers.
non_claims: Tariffs, asymptotic complexity, or model-only estimates cannot close this goal.
goal_contracts.title: At least 100x lower cost per accepted useful task
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: One-sided lower confidence bound on matched cost ratio

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Lower confidence bound of UMRL-009 is at least 100,000,000 with complete matched ledgers.
non_claims: This is a moonshot target, not a present capability claim.
goal_contracts.title: At least 100,000,000x lower cost per accepted useful task
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: One-sided lower confidence bound on matched cost ratio

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has a simultaneous lower bound N_eq>=1e8 for GPU service under UMRL-008.
non_claims: Qubit count, FLOP analogy, or one kernel does not establish GPU-fleet replacement.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 GPUs
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Simultaneous bottleneck lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has a simultaneous lower bound N_eq>=1e8 for CPU service under UMRL-008.
non_claims: A narrow parallel kernel does not establish general CPU replacement.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 CPUs
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Simultaneous bottleneck lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has a simultaneous lower bound N_eq>=1e8 for NPU application service under UMRL-008.
non_claims: Headline TOPS is not an NPU-equivalence contract.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 NPUs
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Joint application-quality and service-capacity lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has N_eq>=1e8 for a frozen RAM service vector under UMRL-008 and passes UMRL-013.
non_claims: Unmeasurable amplitudes are not RAM bytes.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 RAM units
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Coordinate-wise service lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has N_eq>=1e8 for a frozen accelerator-memory service vector under UMRL-008 and passes UMRL-013.
non_claims: Avoided classical intermediates count only for the specific accepted application.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 VRAM/HBM units
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Coordinate-wise service lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: One physically closed UQPU has N_eq>=1e8 for a frozen persistent-storage service vector under UMRL-008 and passes UMRL-013.
non_claims: Transient quantum state is not persistent storage.
goal_contracts.title: One UQPU versus approximately 100,000,000 persistent-storage units
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Coordinate-wise service and durability lower bound

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Every conjunct of UMRL-010 passes with all essential dependencies physically inside the declared phone boundary.
non_claims: A handset terminal backed by remote infrastructure does not pass.
goal_contracts.title: Extreme data-center-scale useful capability in one affordable phone-class device
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Simultaneous mission-wide conservative bounds

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-017 passes for the requirement vector with traceable lot, calibration, custody, and matched control.
non_claims: A published third-party effect is not a project device reproduction.
goal_contracts.title: Qualified quantum/photonic/semiconductor device primitive
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Metrology, drift, sample, lot, and control uncertainty

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-017 yield and UMRL-018 cost pass under a documented reproducible process window.
non_claims: A process roadmap or single good die is not manufacturability.
goal_contracts.title: Least-cost manufacturable device/factory route
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Lot-to-lot yield and cost distribution

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Functional margin passes, UMRL-019 shows reduction, UMRL-020 closes, and lifecycle cost is competitive.
non_claims: Biomass carbon does not create unfed metal or rare-earth atoms.
goal_contracts.title: Pangola/biomass functional material substitution, minimization, recovery, or redesign
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Material-property, mass-balance, durability, and lifecycle-cost uncertainty

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Accepted product quality passes and the conservative interval for UMRL-021 beats the competitive delivered-energy reference.
non_claims: Crude liquid volume is not saleable fuel or delivered energy.
goal_contracts.title: Ultra-low-cost accepted biomass liquid-fuel or refinery-intermediate service
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Joint process-yield, quality, price, uptime, and finance distribution

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-022 is net positive and conservative UMRL-023 is competitive for reliable delivered electricity.
non_claims: Ignition, plasma gain, or gross thermal output is not cheap net electricity.
goal_contracts.title: Ultra-low-cost reliable net fusion electricity
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Plant-wide correlated physics, reliability, schedule, and cost uncertainty

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-024 falls through observed principal or duration changes; any rate/WACC change has separate evidence.
non_claims: Cheaper technology does not automatically reduce policy rates or WACC.
goal_contracts.title: Interest-cost and R&D-finance compression
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Separate contractual cash-flow uncertainty from market-rate scenarios

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: A candidate satisfies UMRL-027 and every applicable UMRL-028 conjunct with independent evidence before mission use.
non_claims: UQPU-UMRL itself is not a physical law and no candidate is promoted by elegance or fit alone.
goal_contracts.title: Discover, test, and retain useful new mathematical equations or structures
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Predictive, parameter, domain, and model-selection uncertainty are separate

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Preregistered UMRL-025 protocol survives leakage, null, multiplicity, calibration, and independent-replication gates.
non_claims: Association is not source attribution; fiction is not empirical evidence.
goal_contracts.title: SCM measurement/information research with strict source boundary
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Preregistered null distribution, power, multiplicity, and effect interval

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Frozen AI task quality passes and measured UMRL-007/009 results respect the UMRL-026 residual-cost bound.
non_claims: Toy-model quality or model-only energy is not frontier-AI cost compression.
goal_contracts.title: Radical AI training/service cost compression
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Held-out quality and complete lifecycle resource intervals

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: UMRL-016 certificate, phase synthesis, independent reconstruction, UMRL-015 budget, provider transpile receipt, and hardware result all pass for any hardware claim.
non_claims: A bounded polynomial or parser round trip is not provider transpilation or hardware execution.
goal_contracts.title: Certified QOS/QSVT synthesis, reconstruction, resources, and execution
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Certified analytic/numeric bounds plus execution uncertainty

goal_contracts.decision_predicate: Every canonical goal contract is present and every UMRL-030 conjunct passes without cross-goal compensation.
non_claims: Progress in one lane cannot cancel a failed gate in another lane.
goal_contracts.title: Conjunctive closure of all project goals
goal_contracts.uncertainty_rule: Simultaneous conservative goal-wise bounds

non_claims: This registry is a formal specification, not a discovered physical law.
All goal states are OPEN; no North-Star, 100x, 100,000,000x, hardware, material, energy, SCM, or commercial target is claimed achieved.
Equation identifiers express definitions, identities, bounds, hypotheses, or decision predicates with distinct evidence requirements.
A future equation may extend an incumbent model only after the explicit UMRL-027 and UMRL-028 gates pass.
